parents.subject: Information Sciences
parents.course: Advanced Topics in Preservation & Tech Services

ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite: IS 562 - Admin and Use of Archival Material. Provides seminar discussions and a hands-on processing experience that applies current theories and practices utilized to solve the most common problems that are encountered by today's archivists and curators when arranging and describing historical records, archives, manuscripts, and artifacts. Issues of intellectual and physical arrangement, description, and access are addressed. Graduate student questions may be sent to ischool-advising@illinois.edu
